purpose: Regression scenarios for default activation, visible marker, deduplication, explicit disable/restore, the unchanged understanding gate, latest-wins behavior, and final delivery checks. Evaluate the actual SKILL.md with an independent agent; do not infer behavioral passes from this file alone.
